fusions.name: Report From the Heels
fusions.desc: A hind kick fires a packed slug of earth at the first enemy in line, dealing 34 damage that ignores armour.

fusions.name: Cracking Stamp
fusions.desc: Your hooves crack down with a sharp report, dealing 12 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and stunning each for 1 second.

fusions.name: Sighted Down the Mane
fusions.desc: Increases your critical hit chance by 25% for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Ricochet Kick
fusions.desc: When you land a critical hit, a shot leaps to the nearest enemy within 8 tiles, dealing 6 damage. Once every 4 seconds.
